mxCell.value: Figure 3.4.2: Physical Database Design (MySQL 8.0 / InnoDB Engine Storage & B-Tree Index Topology)

TABLE: audit_events (ENGINE=InnoDB, ROW_FORMAT=DYNAMIC, CHARSET=utf8mb4)
PHYSICAL COLUMN SPECIFICATION:
* id : CHAR(36) NOT NULL [36 Bytes Clustered Primary Key Inode]
* organization_id : CHAR(36) NOT NULL [36 Bytes Tenant Isolation Key]
* sequence_number : BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL [8 Bytes Monotonic Sequence 1, 2, 3...]
* event_action : VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL [1-100 Bytes UTF-8 Variable String]
* actor_id : VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL [1-100 Bytes Principal Identifier]
* target_id : VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL [1-100 Bytes Entity Subject]
* payload : TEXT NOT NULL [LOB Overflow Page Storage, RFC 8785 Canonical JSON]
* record_hash : CHAR(64) NOT NULL [64 Bytes Hexadecimal SHA-256 Digest]
* prev_record_hash : CHAR(64) NOT NULL [64 Bytes Predecessor Digest Link]
* created_at : DATETIME(6) NOT NULL [8 Bytes Microsecond Precision UTC Timestamp]
B-TREE INDEX TOPOLOGY & BUFFER ALLOCATION:
1. PRIMARY KEY (id) USING BTREE [Clustered Index, In-Memory Buffer Pool]
2. UNIQUE KEY uq_org_seq (organization_id, sequence_number) USING BTREE [Composite Cover]
3. KEY idx_org_created (organization_id, created_at) USING BTREE [Time-Range Scan Acceleration]
4. KEY idx_record_hash (record_hash) USING BTREE [O(log N) Cryptographic Point Lookup]

TABLE: chain_heads (Pessimistic Row Lock)
PHYSICAL SPECIFICATIONS:
* organization_id : CHAR(36) NOT NULL [PK Inode]
* head_sequence_number : BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL
* head_record_hash : CHAR(64) NOT NULL [SHA-256]
* genesis_hash : CHAR(64) NOT NULL [64 Zeros]
* updated_at : DATETIME(6) NOT NULL [Microsecond]
LOCKING TOPOLOGY:
PRIMARY KEY (organization_id) USING BTREE
Target of SELECT ... FOR UPDATE exclusive row lock

TABLE: checkpoints (WORM Storage Anchors)
PHYSICAL SPECIFICATIONS:
* id : CHAR(36) NOT NULL [36 Bytes PK]
* organization_id : CHAR(36) NOT NULL [FK Inode]
* sequence_number : BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL
* checkpoint_hash : CHAR(64) NOT NULL [SHA-256]
* storage_provider : VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL
* s3_bucket : VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL
* s3_object_key : VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL
* s3_version_id : VARCHAR(100) [WORM Version]
* created_at : DATETIME(6) NOT NULL [Microsecond]
INDEX TOPOLOGY:
PRIMARY KEY (id) USING BTREE
KEY idx_cp_org_seq (organization_id, sequence_number)

HARDWARE, MEMORY & OUT-OF-BAND IMMUTABILITY POLICIES
1. Buffer Pool Optimization (innodb_buffer_pool_size = 256M):
Indexes uq_org_seq and chain_heads are locked resident in RAM. This provides sub-millisecond execution times for pessimistic write locks and eliminates disk I/O bottlenecks during peak transaction ingestion bursts.

2. Zero Page Splitting Overhead:
Because sequence numbers strictly increment by +1 (1, 2, 3...) per tenant, all B-Tree leaf insertions occur monotonically at the rightmost page node, ensuring 100% fill factor with zero index fragmentation or page splits.

3. Out-of-Band Hardware Immutability (AWS S3 Object Lock COMPLIANCE Mode):
Checkpoint digests are replicated directly to AWS S3 Object Lock buckets with Legal Hold ON, encrypted via dedicated AWS KMS Customer Managed Keys. S3 WORM hardware-level write protection rejects all database administrator (DBA) delete or overwrite operations.
